exposure: Kiwi OmniCup system group vs. forceps group
cohort: Women who gave birth to singleton term neonates in a cephalic presentation and underwent assisted vaginal delivery from 2017 to 2021
finding: The Kiwi OmniCup system was associated with a lower rate of severe neonatal morbidity compared to forceps delivery, without increasing the incidence of severe maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: The Kiwi OmniCup system reduced severe neonatal morbidity compared with forceps-assisted delivery.
